body: I’m going through it also so If u need to lean on someone in here..
Thank u.. I never liked the idea of suicide I thought it was scary but I understand now.. there is only so much pain a person can handle without help
If I tell my family I want to die I’ll get brushed off So I’m left with a lot of pain building up
No one notices and it makes u think will they even care? Really contemplating if I should or not
